checks.name: Strict intents reject unknown keys, getters, forged owner/facts, sparse or subclass arrays and coercion objects
Create is persistent canonical idempotency; altered intent conflicts; creating another basket preserves previous content
Owner reads/writes, archived sessions, student binding changes and inactive students refuse without mutation
Candidate returns complete host facts/contentVersion; legitimate bookmark version change does not prevent add
Source change between candidate and add is rejected atomically, preserving the teacher-visible version
Add rejects repeated ID/content, missing answer, unsupported facts and wrong section/type
CAS and retry ordering: same committed add survives stale expectedRevision, changed intent conflicts, new stale request refuses
Section ordering requires exact membership; stable entry IDs survive reorder and no-op leaves revision unchanged
Exact pending snapshot uses only selected IDs in canonical order and the same writer; no candidate scan or automatic fill
Confirm and real synchronous file-install boundary recheck basket revision; UI preferences do not invalidate content
Retry returns original paper identity with current stale status after later basket edit; no second pending row
Blueprint changes retain orphan/mismatched and excess members; incomplete snapshots fail without partial paper
Move validates target type/index/source quota and preserves canonical section order and entry identity
Read keeps pinned facts while changed source/file blocks snapshot and confirmation; it never rebases or substitutes
Cancellation after writes atomically rolls back members/ledger/pending, including final asynchronous validation lease
Concurrent connections cannot both mutate one revision; loser changes no ledger/member; fresh stale request conflicts
Source-only/hybrid/original modes enforce current group/kind/owner references and exact source quotas
Archive retains facts/history; remove is explicit; actual SQLite close/reopen restores content revision and UI preferences
Typed IPC denies untrusted frame, validates before lease access, and maps cancellation/errors without returning empty success
Old source-only v1 snapshot/confirm/file compile remains compatible without basket binding
Basket generated qualification comes from actual teacher quality confirmation and saved question ledger, not source labels
Actual parent and generated saved-version changes block basket snapshot/confirmation and retain pinned facts
Corrupt actual confirmed effect marks generated entry unavailable without erasing or hiding pinned basket; snapshot rolls back
Actual Office approval generates and installs real basket-bound DOCX with artifact lineage under same-connection source lease
Actual Office install refuses a basket mutation after its last preview check; no second file/fact and old delivered bytes remain intact
9,999 UI receipts allow the last preference write without changing content revision; 10,001st rolls back only that UI intent
At full UI capacity, domain add/exact snapshot/create/archive remain writable and retries never duplicate members or pending papers
Legacy shared-cap receipts stay byte-identical and retryable while a full old UI allocation cannot block new domain capacity
Full domain allocation rejects only new domain intent; committed domain/UI retries still precede quota and CAS checks
Generated paper v2 requires explicit approved-session scope; v1 and forged authority cannot enable it
Real teacher-approved original and variation effects project through the existing ledger; pending and rejected stay excluded
AI-original 100-point paper uses actual current approved original, canonical type alias and zero-parent provenance
Hybrid quota reserves source slots and generation slots rather than greedily filling both from abundant bank questions
Original shortage cannot be satisfied by an approved variation or unrelated session; shortage shows exact source quota
Editing an approved question invalidates preview, final approval and Office source installation without new model calls
Variation parent changes remove its eligibility; original remains independent without fabricated parents
Unreadable original resource removes approved variation eligibility under the same paper source lease
Corrupt confirmed generation effect or unknown policy cannot authorize selection or silently use displayed tags
Legacy confirmed generation without quality review stays readable but does not acquire generated-paper eligibility
New paper effect binds exact generation receipt; tampered source labels or counts fail instead of relabeling original questions
Generated-paper cancel after write rolls back; rejection and confirmation retry preserve facts and exact snapshot
Three-mode current snapshots and approvals survive actual SQLite close/reopen with no source rewrite
Native same-Pi paper tool accepts original mode, waits for teacher and publishes no ledger IDs or approval digests

boundary: Real owned SQLite/files; controlled sources; no Electron/model/full build
